chunk_list: ATLAS-2 STORAGE EXPANSION PROCUREMENT DECISION V1.0 Purpose This document records the comparison and purchasing decision for expansion of Atlas-2 storage. The need results from growth in ARIADNA corpora, LUMEN images, VERDANT products, and project working copies. Requirements The solution must provide at least 120 TB of usable capacity, tolerance of two disk failures, compatibility with the current system, monitoring, a five-year warranty, and delivery before 31 August 2026. The purchase includes disks, enclosures, controller, installation, and testing. Offers Three comparable offers were received. Offer A has the lowest price but only a three-year warranty. Offer B meets every requirement and includes installation and a recovery test. Offer C provides greater capacity but exceeds the available budget and has an incompatible delivery date. Decision Offer B is selected for EUR 38,450, taxes included. The decision is not based on price alone: it includes warranty, compatibility, support, delivery, and restoration evidence.

The expense is allocated to LabOps and the ARIADNA and LUMEN infrastructure budgets. Conditions Acceptance requires an inventory, component checksums, SMART testing, a simulated failure, restoration of a sample, and an update to the Atlas-2 manual. Final payment is released after compliant receipt. Additional condition 1 Comparison used a matrix covering usable capacity, performance, redundancy, warranty, support, delivery, installation, and total cost. Offers failing a mandatory requirement were marked non-compliant before scoring. Additional condition 2 Receipt separates physical delivery, installation, testing, and acceptance. A signed delivery note does not demonstrate that the solution meets required capacity or fault tolerance. The test remains as case evidence. Additional condition 3 Any model or component change requires prior approval. A substitute must maintain or improve capacity, warranty, and compatibility without increasing the accepted price.
